title: Tourism stakeholders in Negros, Siquijor told to prepare for El Niño

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – The Department of Tourism-Negros Island Region (DOT-NIR) has urged tourism stakeholders to take proactive measures in preparation for the impacts of very strong El Niño, which could bring warmer temperatures and below-normal rainfall across most parts of the country. On Tuesday, the DOT-NIR issued an advisory addressed particularly to local government units (LGUs), tourism officers, tourism establishments, tourism workers, tour operators, tour guides and transport providers in Negros Occidental, Negros Oriental, Siquijor and Bacolod City.
